headline: Vaswani Industries Limited files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Vaswani Industries Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) of the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signalling a material change in shareholding or control event requiring exchange notification.
detail: Vaswani Industries Limited submitted to NSE a disclosure under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31 disclosures are mandatory when a person acquires shares or voting rights exceeding specified thresholds (typically 25% or more, or when control passes), and must include the acquirer's name, the number and percentage of shares/voting rights acquired, the consideration, timing of acquisition, and the source of funds. The filing indicates a substantial shareholding or control shift at the target company, though the specific acquisition amount, acquirer identity, and consideration remain unrevealed in the headline document.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 31
triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure triggers when a person acquires shares or voting rights crossing 25% (or control) threshold; must disclose within 4 working days of acquisition; failure to disclose attracts enforcement action and trading restrictions.

If acquisition crosses 25% and no exemption applies, mandatory open offer at ≥26% above CTC is triggered; exemptions include creeping acquisition (within 6-month rolling window), bonus/rights issue, pledge release, and inter-se promoter transfers.
If combined turnover of acquirer + target ≥₹2,000 cr, CCI approval is required before acquisition; failure to notify is a civil and criminal violation.
